description: Arx monthly security report. action get (default): the report for one website (serviceId or domain) and finished month (month YYYY-MM, default last month): attacks stopped, the most common attack types, malware scans, known vulnerabilities, protection measures in place, security updates Arx installed. A line with no data is left out. action months: the months you can open. action email: whether the monthly report email is on for the organisation and whether you may change it (canChange); pass enabled true or false to change it (organisation-wide, applies to all websites; only the organisation owner or an admin).

action.description: get (default): one site's report; months: months you can open; email: read or set the monthly report email.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

enabled.description: email: true or false turns the monthly report email on or off for the organisation.

month.description: get: finished month YYYY-MM (default last month).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_arx_monthly_report
title: Arx monthly security report
